summary: Computes and clamps a brake cooling effectiveness factor on the vehicle object in a1. Forms a temperature delta at this+0x3A04 by subtracting this+0x34A8 from itself, then when the delta is positive selects a source value through a cooling-mode branch tree: a direct value at this+0x3990 (gated by a byte at this+0x39EC and a selector at this+0x3A08), or wheel averages of this+0x35B0/0x36A8/0x37A0/0x3898 selected by the mode at this+0x39B4, then applies an index lookup table (index from this+0x3A08, low range base 14796, high range base 18464), and writes (v2 - this+0x3994 + 50.0) * 0.0099999998 into this+0x3570 clamped to [0,1]. When the delta is not positive, copies this+0x3A08 into this+0x39F0 instead.

operations.description: Form the temperature delta: v1 = *(float*)(this+0x3A04) - *(float*)(this+0x34A8), then store v1 back into this+0x3A04.
Branch on the delta: when v1 is not greater than 0.0, take the else path and copy the selector *(this+0x3A08) into this+0x39F0.
When the byte at this+0x39EC is nonzero and the dword at this+0x3A08 equals 1, take the direct path v2 = *(float*)(this+0x3990) without the lookup table.

Else path: read the cooling mode v3 = *(int*)(this+0x39B4) and select the wheel average: when v3 is 0, v5 = (*(this+0x3898) + *(this+0x37A0)) * 0.5; when v3 is 1, v5 = (*(this+0x3898) + *(this+0x37A0) + *(this+0x36A8) + *(this+0x35B0)) * 0.25; when v3 is 2, v5 = (*(this+0x36A8) + *(this+0x35B0)) * 0.5; otherwise v5 = *(float*)&a1, a decompiler artifact reading the low dword of the this pointer.

Index the cooling lookup tables with the selector v6 = *(this+0x3A08) (forced to 0 when it equals -1): when v6 > 7, v7 = v5 * *(float*)(this + 4*v6 + 18464); otherwise v7 = v5 * *(float*)(this + 4*v6 + 14796); then v2 = -v7.

Write the cooling effectiveness factor: *(float*)(this+0x3570) = (v2 - *(float*)(this+0x3994) + 50.0) * 0.0099999998. The compiled constants 50.0, 0.0099999998 and the 0.5/0.25/0.99999998-family scalars are emitted from the six single-precision globals (flt_59E43C, flt_59E440, flt_59E444, flt_59E450, flt_59E7F8, flt_59E828); the exact global-to-constant binding is not determinable from this packet.
Clamp the effectiveness factor at this+0x3570 to [0,1]: when it is below 0.0 write 0 (dword), when it exceeds 1.0 write the single-precision 1.0 bit pattern 1065353216.

The two lookup tables indexed by this+0x3A08 (base 14796 and base 18464, each element 4 bytes, split at index 7) have no per-slot meaning in this packet.
